tools.name: get_time_tracker_activities
tools.title: List time tracking activities
tools.description: Lists the activities the current user can book time on (those of the user's teams). Use an activity_id from this list to create a time entry.

tools.name: list_time_tracker_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: Lists the clients an entry can be attached to.

tools.name: list_time_tracker_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: Lists the projects an entry can be attached to, optionally only those of one client.

client_id.description: Only the projects of this client.

tools.name: list_time_tracker_sales_orders
tools.title: List sales orders
tools.description: Lists the sales orders an entry can be attached to, optionally only those of one client.

client_id.description: Only the sales orders of this client.

tools.name: get_time_tracker_locations
tools.title: List locations and offices
tools.description: Lists the locations and offices (codes and labels) an entry can use.

tools.name: list_time_tracker_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: Lists all the time tracking teams. Reserved to time-tracking managers.

tools.name: list_time_entries
tools.title: List my time entries
tools.description: Lists timesheet entries, newest first, with the total hours of the returned page. Defaults to the current user's own; time-tracking managers can pass username or team_id.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default 10, max 100).

username.description: Manager only: list this user's entries instead of the current user's.

team_id.description: Manager only: list the entries of every member of this team (id from list_time_tracker_teams). Takes precedence over username.

tools.name: get_last_time_entry
tools.title: Get my last time entry
tools.description: Returns the current user's most recent time entry, handy to repeat or duplicate it.

tools.name: get_timesheet_summary
tools.title: Summarise a timesheet
tools.description: Totals a timesheet over a date range (max 366 days): hours per day, activity, project and client, plus Monday-to-Friday days with no entry and, when expected_daily_hours is given, weekdays below it. Use it to find what is missing to fill.

expected_daily_hours.description: Hours expected per weekday, e.g. 8. Optional.

username.description: Manager only: summarise this user's timesheet instead of the current user's.

tools.name: create_time_entry
tools.title: Create a time entry
tools.description: Books time for the current user on an activity for a given day.

activity_id.description: Id of an activity returned by get_time_tracker_activities.

hours.description: Time spent, in hours (greater than 0, at most 24). 0.5 is half an hour.

location.description: Work location, a code from get_time_tracker_locations. Defaults to the location of the user's last entry; mandatory when there is none and locations are configured.

office.description: Office, a code from get_time_tracker_locations. Defaults to the office of the user's last entry; mandatory when there is none and offices are configured.

client_id.description: Client id, from list_time_tracker_clients. Needed when the activity is booked on a client.

tools.name: update_time_entry
tools.title: Update a time entry
tools.description: Changes one of the current user's timesheet entries. Only the given fields change. Changing the activity clears the entry's client and project.

entry_id.description: Id of the entry, as returned by list_time_entries.

hours.description: New time in hours (greater than 0, at most 24).

description.description: New description. An empty string clears it.

client_id.description: Client id, from list_time_tracker_clients. Needed when the activity is booked on a client.

tools.name: duplicate_time_entry
tools.title: Duplicate a time entry over a date range
tools.description: Copies one of the current user's entries onto every day from from_date to to_date (both included, at most 366 days). Weekends are skipped unless include_weekends is true. Not idempotent: running it twice creates the copies twice.

entry_id.description: Id of the entry, as returned by list_time_entries.

include_weekends.description: Also create entries on Saturdays and Sundays (default false).

tools.name: delete_time_entry
tools.title: Delete a time entry
tools.description: Deletes one of the current user's timesheet entries.

entry_id.description: Id of the entry, as returned by list_time_entries.
